subject: Request: SOC 2 / SIG — identity assertion timelines & provisioning correlation
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@evergreen.health>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 / SIG — identity assertion timelines & provisioning correlation

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on — Evergreen's security team is working through the SIG/SOC2 artifact intake and we need a set of identity and provisioning artifacts to complete the review. Can you provide the following (even as a sampled bundle) by COB July 10? If sampling is preferred, please include sampling methodology notes.

Requested items:
- SCIM deltas for Jan 1 2026 — Jun 15 2026 (including sequence IDs, timestamps, and delta types: create/update/delete)
- SAML assertion samples (raw assertions) aligned to auth events for a 72-hour window we’ll specify — we may ask for specific timestamps after initial review
- Authentication logs that map assertion/ID to user principal and device IPs (UTC timestamps preferred)
- Role-to-permission mapping (current RBAC matrix) and any role name aliases used by your provisioning layer
- A short narrative describing how you correlate provisioning events to authz (what keys map across systems, e.g., external_id, email, SCIM id)
- Notes on service account handling / JIT provisioning events if present

Attachments: I attached a short intake scope (initial_scope.xlsx) and our current inventory export to help you map fields. We may need a brief working session next week to align on sampling windows.

Let me know if this timeline works or if we should stagger delivery.

Best,
Liam O'Neill
Security Engineering — Evergreen Health
liam.oneill@evergreen.health

Attachment stubs: initial_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet), current_user_inventory.csv (csv)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@evergreen.health>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 / SIG — identity assertion timelines & provisioning correlation

Hi Liam,

Thanks — we can assemble a sampled evidence bundle and will include sampling notes. A few quick clarifications so we scope correctly:

1) For SAML assertions, do you want the full raw assertion (base64-decoded) plus the HTTP-POST/Redirect metadata, or is a redacted sample sufficient?
2) Do you need all service accounts included or only user principals?
3) For the authentication logs, do you want session-level logs (session start/stop) or only assertion-level events?

Proposed plan:
- Draft bundle (SCIM deltas + SAML samples + authz matrix + narrative) by Thu, Jul 8
- Final bundle and handoff to your team by Fri, Jul 10

If that timeline works I'll coordinate internally and set up a 30m sync for Mon/Tue next week to confirm sampling windows. CC'd Grace (security/compliance lead) and Sean (enterprise lead) so they're looped.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Artifact collection plan for Evergreen Health (SOC2/SIG)

Team —

Per Liam's intake, here's how I propose we split work and what artifacts we'll generate (deliver to shared folder link below). Target: draft pack by Jul 8, final by Jul 10.

Grace — SCIM and provisioning
- Export SCIM delta stream for 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-15 (include sequence IDs, timestamps, actor id, delta type). Save as scim_delta_202601-202606.csv.
- Pull provisioning webhook delivery logs and any enrichment steps that map external_id -> internal_id. Note any gaps/redactions.

Sean — SAML & authz mapping
- Export a sample set of base64-decode SAML assertions for selected auth events in June (start with 6/10–6/12 window). Save as saml_assertion_samples_202606.txt.
- Produce a session/claim mapping extract that correlates assertion IDs to user principals and session ids.

Jonas (me) — RBAC & narrative
- Draft authz_matrix_draft.xlsx with role -> permission mapping and any role aliases.
- Provide narrative: keys used to correlate events across systems (email, scim.id, external_id), and the runbook used for redaction.

Storage and links:
- Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AabCdefGhIjKlmno (create Evergreen/2026-SIG folder)
- HubSpot ticket: HS-7321 (log progress against deal)

Attachments we'll stage: scim_delta_202601-202606.csv, saml_assertion_samples_202606.txt, authz_matrix_draft.xlsx

Notes: preserve original timestamps in UTC, do not redact request ids in the sample files unless we have a legal requirement — flag any PII elements we remove. If service accounts are noisy, sample at 10% but include sampling method in the readme.

I'll take point on the bundle handoff. Grace/Sean — ack to this thread with your ETA and any blockers.

Thanks,
Jonas
